title: How much does a trip to the Bahamas cost?
summary: See how much a trip to the Bahamas costs from five regions, with flights, resorts and daily spend, plus a budget range for each. Compare.
body_markdown:
A trip to the Bahamas can cost a few hundred dollars or several thousand, depending on where you’re travelling from, how long you plan to stay, and the kind of holiday you want. Flights, accommodation, food, local transport, and activities all affect your budget. If you’re travelling during peak season, expect to pay more for flights and hotels.


Looking at trip packages to the Bahamas can help you plan your spending before you book. Some packages combine flights and accommodation, while others include meals, airport transfers, or excursions. These options can make budgeting easier, but check what’s included so you don’t end up paying extra for things you expected to be covered.


Your travel dates and choice of island also matter. Nassau and Paradise Island offer plenty of resorts and activities, while other islands may suit a quieter getaway. In this guide, you’ll learn what to budget for flights, hotels, food, and activities so you can plan a Bahamas trip that fits your wallet.


## **How much does a trip to the Bahamas cost?**


A 7-day trip to the Bahamas can cost around $1,000 per person for a budget holiday, about $2,000 for a mid-range trip, or more than $4,300 for a luxury stay. Your final cost depends on where you stay, how you travel, and the activities you choose.


Accommodation is one of the biggest expenses, with standard resorts averaging around $242 per night. Food can also take up a large part of your budget, especially if you eat at sit-down restaurants, where daily spending may reach 100–200 per person. Excursions add to the cost, too. Popular Exuma boat tours can range from $215 to over $570, depending on the experience.


Getting around also matters. Local jitney buses are generally cheaper than private taxis, helping you save money on transport. When comparing trip packages to the Bahamas, check whether flights, hotel stays, meals, transfers, and activities are included. This helps you compare the total cost and avoid unexpected expenses.


## **How much does a trip to the Bahamas cost from Europe?**


A one-week trip to the Bahamas from Europe can cost around €2,000 to €5,000 per person, depending on your departure city, accommodation, and travel plans. Budget travellers may spend €2,000 to €2,800, while mid-range holidays can cost €3,000 to €5,000. Luxury trips can cost considerably more.


**Flights:** Return flights from Europe to the Bahamas typically cost around **€500 to €900** , although prices vary by season, airline, and booking date. You may also need connecting flights, which can affect your travel time and total fare.


**Accommodation:** Hotels and resorts are often a major expense. Budget hotels help keep costs down, while beachfront and all-inclusive resorts can cost much more per night.


**Daily expenses:** Food, transport, and excursions add to your budget. To save money, compare flight prices, travel outside peak periods, and check what your hotel package includes before booking.

## **How much does a trip to the Bahamas cost from Africa?**


A one-week trip to the Bahamas from Africa can cost around $2,200 to $4,500 per person, depending on your departure city, flights, accommodation, and activities. Travelling from cities like Lagos or Johannesburg can be expensive because flights usually involve connections through Europe or the United States.


**Flights:** Return flights from major African cities to Nassau may cost around $1,100 to $1,600, depending on the airline, season, and booking date. Check different routes and travel dates to find a suitable fare.


**Accommodation:** Budget travellers can save by staying in guesthouses or affordable hotels. Mid-range travellers may spend more on three-star resorts and comfortable accommodation close to popular attractions.


**Daily expenses:** Food, local transport, and excursions add to the total. Budget travellers can spend around $2,100 to $2,600 for the week, while mid-range trips may cost $3,100 to $4,500 per person.


Before booking, compare flight and hotel prices separately and allow extra money for[travel insurance](https://grey.co/blog/how-to-get-travel-insurance) , visa requirements where applicable, and unexpected expenses.


## **How much does a trip to the Bahamas cost from South America?**


A one-week trip to the Bahamas from South America can cost around $1,800 to $4,000 per person, depending on your departure city, accommodation, and activities. Your total budget will depend on flight prices and the type of holiday you want.


**Flights:** Return flights from South American cities to Nassau may cost around $600 to $1,200. Prices vary by country, airline, travel season, and whether you need connecting flights.


**Accommodation:** Budget hotels and guesthouses help keep costs lower, while beachfront resorts and all-inclusive hotels can increase your spending significantly.


**Daily expenses:** Food, transport, and excursions add to your total. You can save by eating at local restaurants, using affordable transport, and booking activities in advance.


## **Trip to the Bahamas cost breakdown**


The table below compares the cost of a six-night stay in the Bahamas for one traveller departing from Africa. It covers two options: a mid-range resort and a budget-friendly Airbnb, with estimated costs for flights, accommodation, food, activities, and local transport.

Flights $1,400 $1,400

### **Key differences**


- **Accommodation:** A mid-range resort offers more amenities but can cost considerably more, especially when resort fees apply. An Airbnb may help you save on accommodation, particularly if you choose a less expensive island or neighbourhood.
- **Food and drinks:** Restaurant meals can take up a large part of your budget. Eating at local spots such as Fish Fry stalls and preparing some meals with groceries can help reduce spending.
- **Transport and activities:** Private airport taxis and organised excursions add to resort holiday costs. Budget travellers can save by using public jitney buses where available and enjoying free activities such as beach hopping.

## **Frequently asked questions about the cost of a trip to the Bahamas**


### **How much does a trip to the Bahamas cost?**


A mid-range seven-day trip to the Bahamas costs around $2,000 to $3,500 per person, depending on where you travel from. This estimate covers flights, accommodation, meals, local transport, and a few popular excursions.


### **Are travel packages cheaper?**


Yes, travel packages can save you money by combining flights and accommodation into one booking. Compare package prices with separate bookings, check what is included, and look for deals on all-inclusive resorts in Nassau and Paradise Island.


### **What currency do they use?**


The Bahamas uses the Bahamian dollar (BSD), which is pegged at one-to-one with the US dollar. Both currencies are widely accepted, so US dollars are convenient for visitors. However, you may receive Bahamian dollars as change.


### **When is the best time to save?**


August to November can offer lower flight and hotel prices because it falls within the quieter travel season. However, this period overlaps with hurricane season, so check weather forecasts, cancellation policies, and travel insurance before booking.


### **Do African citizens need a visa?**


Visa requirements depend on your nationality and travel circumstances. Many African passport holders need a Bahamian visa, while some may qualify for exemptions. Check the official Bahamas immigration requirements and any US or European transit visa rules before booking.


### **How can you save on food?**


Save on meals by visiting local food spots instead of dining exclusively at resorts. Arawak Cay’s Fish Fry is popular for Bahamian dishes such as conch salad and fried seafood. Mixing local meals with groceries can help keep daily food costs manageable.
